leadText: Mitsunari (Japanese: ミツナリ) is a Warlord in Pokémon Conquest. He is friends with two other Warlords, Masanori and Kiyomasa.
plainText:
Mitsunari (Japanese: ミツナリ) is a Warlord in Pokémon Conquest. He is friends with two other Warlords, Masanori and Kiyomasa.

==In the games==
 
 

===Warlord information===
====Rank I====
 

====Rank II====
 , Kiyomasa, Mitsunari, Masanori, Shingen, and Oichi having a feast]]
 
 

Transforms to Rank II by reaching a 60% link with Pawniard or Bisharp.

===Default Pokémon===
 
 
===Links===
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
====Unobtainable links====
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

===Quotes===
Start of turn:
When asleep:
"Asleep. Still."
With low health or a status ailment:
"Come on..."
When victory is near:
"This is just about over."
Otherwise:
"Go."

Start of battle:
When attacking a castle:
"This won't take long."
When defending a castle:
"I won't lose to the likes of you!"

During battle:
"You know, ... Victory in battle is all a matter of reason... In due course, all will become clear."

When ordering to attack:
" . Now."

When delegating:
Before a delegation is chosen:
"What can I do for you?"
After a delegation is chosen:
""Trust me."
When a delegation isn't chosen:
"...Okay."

When ordering to go to battle:
To a kingdom:
"I can't imagine I'll meet with any enemies that could live up to my talents..."
To a wild Pokémon location:
"Let's set off."

Upon forming a link:
"Naturally, I linked with . What Pokémon wouldn't want to be with me?"

When using an item:
" ."

When using his Warrior Skill:
"I'm sick of the sight of you."

After winning a battle:
If he attacked a castle:
"A pathetic opponent."
If he defended a castle:
"My intellect is of a different magnitude than yours."

When defeated:
If recruitable:
"You're quite exceptional, in your way."
If defeated by something other than the enemy:
"Did I make some miscalculation?"
Otherwise:
"You...beat me...? But how? That's impossible..."

When being recruited:
"Very good."

When finding a perfect link:
"Pawniard... There's something about you that's different from other Pokémon. Do you feel the same way about me? I have a feeling that with you around, my future will be brighter still!"

When a Pokémon evolves:
Before evolving:
"What...? What's with ...?"
After Evolution:
"I'm relying on you, you know."

When Pawniard evolves while Mitsunari is Rank II:
"Hey, Bisharp... You seem even stronger than before. You can feel the bond we have, right? I'm counting on your power, Bisharp..."

When transforming:
Before transforming:
"What's this...power...from...within...?"
After transforming:
"I knew I had it in me to reach greater heights"

===Profile===
Says exactly what is on his mind and therefore has a tendency to cause offense sometimes. He has a good head on him, however, and never forgets a favor done for him.

==In the manga==
===Pokémon + Nobunaga's Ambition ~ Ranse's Color Picture Scroll ~===
Mitsunari debuted in PNA1.

Mitsunari is based on the real-life of Japanese history.
